title: Jezreel's Tower
geometryBasis: The official Kent register locates the disused site. The registered 124 foot architectural dimension is used as the representative plan span. Original photography supplies the four identical elevations and the interior proportion controls.
sectionBasis: Chatham Hill’s one-metre present-day terrain anchors the placement. The roofless shell follows the 1903 original images. The section follows the open rounded roof skeleton, encircling galleries, 12 major curved girders and the lower floor depression photographed in the original press.
limitations: The model represents the unfinished tower about August 1903. The exact heights and footprint heading vary among the contemporary accounts and are approximate.

Most floor and steel details are reconstructed at medium distance from the imagery. The modern terrain establishes the location; the old approach, basement depth and surrounding 1903 landscape are estimated.
